name: How long does an exterior restoration project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does an exterior restoration project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an exterior restoration project depends on the scale and complexity of the work. A smaller project, like repairing a few stucco cracks, might take a few days, while a full facade restoration of a large, historic building could extend over several weeks or even months. Factors such as weather conditions, material availability, and the need for specialized craftsmanship can also influence the timeline. We provide a projected schedule during the planning phase after evaluating the specific requirements of your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies greatly based on scale and complexity, from a few days for minor repairs to several months for extensive restorations. Weather and material availability can also impact the timeline.
